name: Gonin!? ~Pitari to Tekichuu! Kyousei Uranai♪~
original_name: ゴニン!? ～ピタリと的中！強制占い♪～
source:
Ryouichi has no job. But one day, he wins a lot of money by lottery. When he walks along the road happily, he meets a fortuneteller. She looks hungry, so he gives her something to eat. Her name is R and puts out some cards.

"Will you tell my fortune?"

"No, I'll decide your future."

"What?"

"I'll show you my power... You'll have sex with a girl you still don't know tomorrow..."

"What are you talking about...?"

Though he doesn't believe it, a girl comes to his place on the next day and they actually have sex. Ryouichi soon meets R.

"Do you believe my power?"

"Yes! Yes!"

"Tell me your wish. I'll make it come true."

Of course, Ryouichi thinks about erotic wishes...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
良一没有工作，但有一天，他买彩票中了许多钱。他兴高采烈地走在路上，遇见一名占卜师。对方看起来很饿，于是他给了她一些食物。她名叫R，随后取出几张牌。

“你要替我占卜吗？”

“不，我要决定你的未来。”

“什么？”

“我会让你见识我的力量…明天，你会和一个现在还不认识的女孩做爱…”

“你在说什么…？”

良一虽然不相信，但第二天真的有一名女孩来到他家，两人还发生了关系。不久，良一再次见到R。

“现在相信我的力量了吗？”

“相信！相信！”

“说出你的愿望吧，我会替你实现。”

良一想到的当然都是色情愿望…
